subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Zeise's salt（K[PtCl₃(η²-C₂H₄)]）？
A. Square planar
B. Tetrahedral
C. Trigonal bipyramidal
D. Trigonal prismatic
explanation: Square planar. Covalent count: Pt (group 10) 10 e; 3 × Cl (X) 3 e; 1 × η²-C₂H₄ (L) 2 e; the 1− charge adds 1 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −3 in all and the complex has a 1− charge, so the metal is Pt(II), d⁸; d⁸ + 8 e from the ligands = 16 e. The first organometallic complex (1827). Ethylene is a 2-electron L ligand.
